name: Arbroath Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank serving Arbroath and surrounding areas

name: Arbroath Community Garden
short_description: Community garden behind the harbour with raised beds and polytunnel
months: this garden grows vegetables for members and donates surplus to local food bank. Regular workdays every Sunday.
